newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish Novo in pact with Schering.
newsitem.headline: Danish Novo in pact with Schering.

text.p: Denmark's leading biotechnology and pharmaceutical group Novo Nordisk A/S announced on Tuesday that it had reached a co-operation agreement on developing fertility products with Germany's Schering AG.
It said the pact was long-term and focused on research to create chemical products to help childless couples to become fertile as well as medical preparations to prevent undesired pregnancies.
